noticias.resumo: Presente na alimentação dos brasileiros e conhecida pelo sabor adocicado e benefícios nutricionais, a banana é uma das frutas mais consumidas no mundo. noticias.resumo: Em outubro, o Valor Bruto da Produção (VBP) da agropecuária foi estimado em R$ 1,46 trilhão, segundo levantamento da Secretaria de Política Agrícola do Ministério da Agricultura. Entre os fatores que contribuíram para o resultado deste ano estão o excesso de chuvas e os períodos de estiagem, que afetaram o desempenho de diferentes culturas ao longo do ano. As lavouras respondem pela maior parcela do VBP, com R$ 938,1 bilhões. O valor representa queda de 3,9% em relação aos R$ 976,26 bilhões registrados em 2025. noticias.titulo: Pork Producers Brace for Historic Losses: Why 2027 Could Be Even Worse
noticias.resumo: After a profitable 2025, pork producers are facing a sharp reversal. Rising costs and softening consumer demand are creating a difficult outlook as producers brace for one of the worst financial years on record. Pork producers are no strangers to market cycles. But after a profitable 2025, the industry is facing a much different outlook, with some of the steepest losses in years potentially ahead. For Adam Chipman, a farmer and pork producer in southwest Iowa’s Shelby County, the past six years have been anything but predictable. “The variability within the marketplace has really been something that we’ve struggled with,” Chipman says. Since 2020, he describes the experience of raising hogs as rollercoaster. Chipman operates a diversified farm with row crops and a feed mill, but raising pigs remains at the heart of the operation. The farm produces approximately 75,000 pigs annually.

noticias.titulo: South Korea set to finish removing 136.6km of ASF wild boar fencing as 2027 phase targets 235.7km
noticias.resumo: Seoul is dismantling part of the 1,630km barrier built to contain African swine fever in wild boar, while adding monitoring of boar movement at fence openings.

noticias.titulo: Indonesia destroys 56 tonnes of Nepalese hides to keep out exotic foot-and-mouth disease strains
noticias.resumo: Quarantine officials in East Java buried the rejected leather shipment, citing FMD serotypes Asia 1 and A that are present in Nepal but not yet found in Indonesia.

noticias.titulo: South Korea confirms bird flu at 16,000-duck farm in Yeongam, 10th case this winter
noticias.resumo: The South Jeolla outbreak is the fourth on a duck farm this season and has triggered testing of 72 poultry farms within 10km and nationwide checks on the affiliate's farms.

noticias.titulo: China's October sorghum imports jump 119% to 780,000 tonnes as corn imports rise 37%
noticias.resumo: Corn imports have doubled and sorghum imports have risen 80% in the first ten months of 2026, according to Chinese customs data. Corn imports have doubled and sorghum imports have risen 80% in the first ten months of 2026, according to Chinese customs data.

noticias.titulo: Indonesia's KKP builds 500 mini-RAS catfish and tilapia sites in 2026 and projects Rp2.88 trillion a year at full scale
noticias.resumo: Of 7,000 sites assessed from Lampung to East Java, 5,000 qualified, though protected paddy land rules are holding some back as the ministry targets 40,000 sites by 2029.

noticias.titulo: China's Zhanjiang breaks ground on RMB82.15 million golden pompano processing hub with 18,000-tonne capacity
noticias.resumo: The Leizhou project aims to add processing and cold storage at Liushawan, where most of China's cage-farmed golden pompano is still sold fresh or chilled.

noticias.titulo: Thai shrimp industry presses new Fisheries Department chief for flood relief, cheap loans and Malaysia market reopening
noticias.resumo: Farm groups want disease testing, half-cost pond motors and faster talks on Malaysia's import suspension, which hits about 10,000 tonnes of southern Thai shrimp a year.

noticias.titulo: Philippines' Borongan City places dairy carabaos with farmers to supply school milk feeding
noticias.resumo: The Eastern Samar city says it needs nearly one million litres of milk a year for its school and daycare feeding programmes and will buy from local raisers first.

noticias.titulo: China's raw milk price has ended a five-year downcycle, says CITIC Securities, forecasting a 4% supply shortage in 2028
noticias.resumo: An 11% cut in the dairy herd and a 30% jump in spot milk prices underpin the broker's view, as Hong Kong-listed dairy farm stocks extend their November rally.

noticias.titulo: UK pig producers lose about GBP25 a head as pig price falls to lowest since May 2022
noticias.resumo: Production costs climbed to 207p/kg in the third quarter while European oversupply pushed the Standard Pig Price down to 176.12p/kg in mid-November.

noticias.titulo: China's white-feather broiler prices hold near RMB3.25 per jin as processors run at a loss
noticias.resumo: Breeder egg prices fell by up to RMB0.20 per egg in most regions on 18 November, while day-old chick prices held steady and some processors rushed export orders.

noticias.titulo: South Korea's wholesale egg prices set to fall further as laying flock grows 2% to 59.18 million
noticias.resumo: Consumer prices remain above KRW7,000 per 30 eggs as new layers enter production, and the rural economic institute expects further wholesale declines in mid-November.

noticias.titulo: Thai broiler raisers oppose all US chicken part imports under reciprocal trade deal
noticias.resumo: The National Broiler Raisers Association says it has had no clear details on poultry imports, while the agriculture ministry says talks on US poultry are unconcluded.

noticias.titulo: Vietnam's Dien Bien breaks ground on VND265 billion high-tech pig farm for 24,000 head
noticias.resumo: The Pa Kin farm in Nua Ngam commune will raise gilts and finishing pigs and is expected to ship 48,000-60,000 market pigs a year from 2028.

noticias.titulo: Natural Biologics appoints Josh Garver as ruminant business development manager for US Great Lakes
noticias.resumo: The Michigan-based nutritionist joins after nearly 11 years in ruminant nutrition and technical service to dairy customers.
